Correlix licence

Correlix core is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Commercial add-on modules are licensed under the Correlix Enterprise License (LicenseRef-Correlix-Enterprise) — see LICENSING.md.

Correlix is open core. The engine, the telemetry pipeline, correlation and RCA, the investigation surface and the tenant isolation model are Apache-2.0. A named set of commercial add-on modules is source-available under the Correlix Enterprise License. Tenant isolation is core in every edition and is never a commercial add-on.

The licence texts ship with the source as LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt and LICENSES/Correlix-Enterprise.txt; LICENSING.md maps every directory to one of the two.

Everything below this box concerns THIRD-PARTY software Correlix redistributes, which keeps its own licences and its own obligations.

or reachable until an operator explicitly runs
`./install-correlix.sh enable self-monitoring`. A Correlix installation that
never enables that add-on contains no AGPL-licensed software at all.

not alter the UI it serves — including its branding. Grafana is configured only
through its own documented interfaces: GF_* environment variables and the
read-only provisioning directory (datasources and dashboards). Configuration is
not modification.

users. Correlix runs Grafana unmodified, in its own container, as its own
process, on its own route. No Correlix code is linked into Grafana, compiled
with it, statically or dynamically bound to it, or derived from it; the two
communicate only over the network and through configuration files. Correlix's
own source is therefore under no AGPL obligation whatsoever.
